source_sha_role: latest code-and-gate baseline before this release manifest update
source_sha_policy: Cloudflare Pages builds the governed dist artifact from main; production acceptance requires live domain, route, API and visual verification.

data_contract.policy: Evidence before amplification; every metric requires a dated snapshot; duplicate URLs collapse at runtime; private, minor, legal, financial and quarantined records are excluded from the public universe.

social_corpus.policy: Person before platform; source-linked public material; metrics only with a dated source.

release_intent: Make Cloudflare Pages the single public static source of truth for 7ya.io; remove the AppDeploy catch-all proxy; publish Igor's personal, social-first homepage with open evidence and a curated cross-platform corpus.
promotion_gate: Promote to READY only after 7ya.io and www.7ya.io resolve to the Cloudflare Pages project, the homepage serves marker 7ya-cloudflare-canonical-20260918-v1, /api/health returns canonical Cloudflare JSON, /api/feed.json serves the current feed, and critical routes pass live verification.
blockers: GitHub Actions cannot currently perform the automated Cloudflare cutover because the GitHub account is locked due to a billing issue.
TinyFish interactive browser automation is unavailable until its wallet is funded; read-only live verification remains available.
rollback: Prior Git commits and the last valid AppDeploy version remain available as rollback references; production routing must not use an AppDeploy catch-all proxy.
